name: Folthid Estate
title: Folthid Estate
summary: Raxanza Folthid's two-story brick house in a deep forest clearing, with a well and a Life Stone; Felscuda's shack and the Folthid Cellar stand 140-190 m west.

shots.standingOrder: Start 4 m above the roof of the Folthid house and pull back south-south-west and up along the view line to 32 m away; stay 5 m from every tree crown.
shots.notes: Lonely house in the deep forest: starts just above the roof of Raxanza Folthid's brick house and pulls back and up (48 degrees) until the clearing, the well and the surrounding tall trees frame it; south-south-west sun behind the lens.
